confounds_reason: The measured quantity is dominated by the causal-mask geometry and the sink rather than by positional encoding. Two direct constructions: (1) on an EXACTLY uniform causal attention pattern -- no positional preference by construction -- the pooled statistic reads -0.434476689478 at L=8, -0.465974010408 at L=64 and -0.466621537069 at L=256 against a correct 0, while the rowwise reads exactly 0.0 at every L; (2) on an iid-logit causal null (20 draws, L=128) pooled is -0.202313 +/- 0.011682 and rowwise +0.002208 +/- 0.019605. EVIDENCE, positional_decay.py:250-256 and RERUN_LEDGER.md round-3 freeze gate: the number offered to justify the headline choice, 'pooled reads 0.2545271629778672 on an exactly uniform causal attention pattern', is an artifact of the fixture, not of uniform attention. tests/tasks/test_geometry.py:834-836 builds attn[:, :, i, :i] = 1/i, which leaves the DIAGONAL at exactly 0.0 and row 0 entirely 0.0 -- the rows do not sum to 1, and the pooled branch (which reads a[q, :q+1]) then pairs distance 0 with the minimum value in every row, flipping the sign.
